items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: That's him, him and Willie Jackson were the two entertainers back there. I've heard plenty about them.

ctx.x: I think they called him Noonie Johnson too.

Oh yeah, Noonie Johnson, yeah, yeah, yeah. That's the same guy? That's the same guy. He was the entertainer. That's right, Noonie Johnson. That's right. Noonie and Noonie? That was his name. That was his name. They called him Noonie. But Noonie Johnson was his name. That's him, him and Willie Jackson were the two entertainers back there. I've heard plenty about them.

Uh-huh. That's right. And I have a wonderful, well a couple of wonderful records by New Orleans Willie Jackson. Yeah. He went up north and he made some, and he made some down here too with us, Steve Lewis, just him and the piano. Yeah.
